name: Construction Project Management
description: Introduction to construction project management, agile project management, scope management, MIS, work breakdown structure and project definition rating index, identification of risk and impact, labour productivity variations, productivity improvements-work study, quality and safety: planning and control, project scheduling techniques-CPM, PERT, PDM, LOB, time and cost management, material related management- purchase and inventory control, time cost resource optimization, measuring project progress and performance-EVA and ES, software based project management.
